$comment: Selected pieces presented in the site viewer. PDFs live under public/works/ and are the published copies from lawsofexistence.com. Order = display order.

works.title: The Declaration of Humanity
works.subtitle: An Inclusive Definition and Its Operational Necessity
works.blurb: Shifts from assertion-form articulations of universal rights to a definitional-form premise: humanity is every person, family, people, and nation, without exception.

works.title: The Fundamental Laws of Supremacism and Egalitarianism
works.blurb: The axiomatic substrate of the framework: sustained conflict necessarily implies a supremacist claim, and fully maintained parity forecloses it.

works.title: The Madisonian Separation of Powers Objective Compliance Test
works.blurb: Recovers Madison's framework and derives a six-step objective compliance test for separation-of-powers violations, validated against 36 Supreme Court decisions spanning 154 years.

works.title: Means, Not Views
works.subtitle: The Constitutional Distinction Between Radicalism and Extremism
works.blurb: Defends the First Amendment distinction between radicalism, which challenges through constitutional means, and extremism, which uses unconstitutional means. The line is drawn at means, not views.

works.title: Bodily Jurisdiction
works.subtitle: The Floor of Constitutional Authority
works.blurb: Restates bodily autonomy structurally rather than as a balanceable right: the body is a sovereign jurisdictional sphere and the floor of the constitutional architecture.

works.title: The Rejection of Law
works.subtitle: Treaty Defection, State Secession, and the Fractal Constitution
works.blurb: Argues that the principle forbidding state secession is structurally identical to the principle that treaty 'unsigning' violates, and that selective enforcement is the rejection of law itself.
